title: Shares of the Declared Trip Cost Under the Travel Protection Plans
content:
Two benefits of the Travel Protection Plans are carried as shares of the declared trip cost rather than as
cash amounts, and a third — cancellation for any reason — exists only on the plans whose schedule says so.

| Plan | Trip cancellation benefit | Trip interruption benefit | Cancel for any reason included | Cancel for any reason share | Notice before departure (hours) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Trip Basics Essential | 75% of declared trip cost | 75% of declared trip cost | No | 0% | 0 |
| Trip Basics Standard | 100% of declared trip cost | 100% of declared trip cost | No | 0% | 0 |
| TripGuard Plus | 100% of declared trip cost | 125% of declared trip cost | No | 0% | 0 |
| TripGuard Premier | 100% of declared trip cost | 150% of declared trip cost | No | 0% | 0 |
| Cancel For Any Reason Elite | 100% of declared trip cost | 150% of declared trip cost | Yes | 75% | 48 |
| Annual Multi-Trip Traveller | 100% of declared trip cost | 125% of declared trip cost | No | 0% | 0 |
| Annual Multi-Trip Executive | 100% of declared trip cost | 150% of declared trip cost | Yes | 60% | 48 |

A share of 0% and a notice period of 0 hours are recorded against a plan that does not carry the benefit.

## What the shares come to

On a declared trip cost of 10000 the trip cancellation benefit is 7500 on Trip Basics Essential, whose share is
75%, and 10000 on every other plan in the range, whose share is 100%. The interruption benefit on the same
declaration is 7500 on Trip Basics Essential, 10000 on Trip Basics Standard, 12500 on TripGuard Plus and on
Annual Multi-Trip Traveller, whose share is 125%, and 15000 on TripGuard Premier, Cancel For Any Reason Elite
and Annual Multi-Trip Executive, whose share is 150%. Those figures are worked for illustration on a
declaration of 10000 and are not terms of any plan.

Only two plans carry cancellation for any reason: Cancel For Any Reason Elite at 75% of the trip cost and
Annual Multi-Trip Executive at 60%, both on notice given at least 48 hours before departure.
